rules.topic: Chemical storage cells come in AE2's own StorageTier sizes (1k, 4k, 16k, 64k, 256k) and inherit the tier byte counts and idle drains from AE2 (see the ae2 rule file: 1024 to 262144 bytes, drain 0.5 to 2.5 AE/t)

rules.quote: super(properties, tier.componentSupplier().get(), housingItem, tier.idleDrain(), tier.bytes() / 1024, tier.bytes() / 128, 5, MekanismKeyType.TYPE);
rules.topic: Unlike AE2 item cells (63 types), a chemical cell holds at most 5 chemical types, with bytes-per-type = tier bytes / 128; plan one cell per chemical production line, not one cell for all chemicals

rules.quote: // Disallow storage cells to contain radioactive stuff
rules.topic: Radioactive chemicals are blacklisted from chemical storage cells (validated per chemical): spent nuclear waste and other radioactive Mekanism chemicals must stay in waste barrels and dedicated handling, never in ME cells
